accept.cmd: pnpm exec tsx -e "(async()=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const s=await import('./tools/harness/src/scenarios/spec.ts');const spec=s.parseGameSpec(fs.readFileSync('docs/specs/trivia-night.md','utf8'));const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('artifacts/tmp/verify/M4-01-g3.json','utf8'));const names=r.testResults.flatMap(f=>f.assertionResults.map(a=>a.fullName));const m=s.missingNumberedTests([...spec.rules,...spec.tests],names);const bluff=['R9','R10','R11','R12','R13','T6','T7','T8','T11'];const bad=m.filter(id=>!bluff.includes(id));console.log(spec.rules.length+' rules, '+spec.tests.length+' cases, '+names.length+' tests, missing (M4-01b Bluff): ['+m.join(',')+'], missing Classic: ['+bad.join(',')+']');if(bad.length>0||spec.rules.length===0||r.numFailedTests>0)process.exit(1)})()"
